what_to_detect: A creature holding the goaded designation is under an attack requirement in its attackers record (must_attack true) while the goad lasts.
near_miss: A creature whose goad has ended (no goaded designation) is under no attack requirement.

what_to_detect: A creature holding the goaded designation is under an attack requirement in its attackers record (must_attack true): it attacks each combat if able.
near_miss: A creature without the goaded designation and under no other requirement: must_attack false.

what_to_detect: An attackers record whose anchor attacker is goaded by two or more different players (two or more goaded_by links leave it): each goading player adds a requirement of its own.
near_miss: An attackers record whose anchor attacker is goaded by one player only, however many times that player goaded it: one requirement.
record_fields: gen-3 links goaded_by (the goaded creature to each player who goaded it)
